interventions.description: Install a planting strip or furniture zone between the sidewalk and the curb to provide physical separation from moving vehicles.

interventions.title: Lane Narrowing and Traffic Calming
interventions.description: Reduce the width of the travel lanes to encourage lower vehicle speeds and provide space for the expanded pedestrian realm or a bike lane.

interventions.title: Mid-block Pedestrian Crossing
interventions.description: Install a marked crosswalk with high-visibility paint and appropriate signage to facilitate safe crossing.

interventions.title: Sidewalk Maintenance
interventions.description: Regularly remove overgrown vegetation to ensure the full width of the sidewalk remains accessible.

interventions.title: Streetscape Enhancements
interventions.description: Improve lighting and add landscaping to mitigate the negative effects of the blank frontage and improve pedestrian comfort.

interventions.title: High-Visibility Crosswalks
interventions.description: Install continental-style marked crosswalks at all legs of the intersection to improve visibility.

interventions.title: Driveway Consolidation
interventions.description: Narrow and clearly define the gas station entrance to reduce the conflict zone and maintain sidewalk continuity.

interventions.title: Continuous Raised Sidewalk
interventions.description: Maintain the sidewalk at its full height across the driveway to reinforce pedestrian right-of-way and slow entering vehicles.

interventions.title: Physical Delineation
interventions.description: Install bollards or planters to clearly separate the pedestrian path from the gas station forecourt.

interventions.title: Sidewalk Maintenance and Clearing
interventions.description: Remove overgrown vegetation and repair the sidewalk surface to provide a clear, accessible path for pedestrians.

interventions.title: Road Diet or Lane Narrowing
interventions.description: Reduce the width of travel lanes or repurpose a lane for a protected bike lane to slow traffic and reduce crossing distances.

interventions.title: High-Visibility Crosswalk
interventions.description: Add a marked crosswalk with high-visibility paint and appropriate signage to designate a safe crossing area.

interventions.title: New Sidewalk Construction
interventions.description: Install a continuous, ADA-compliant sidewalk on the left side of the street to provide safe passage.

interventions.title: Driveway Narrowing
interventions.description: Reduce the width of the gas station access point to shorten pedestrian crossing distance and slow vehicle turns.

interventions.title: Utility Pole Repair
interventions.description: Straighten or replace the leaning utility pole to ensure structural stability and pedestrian safety.

interventions.title: Continuous Sidewalk Delineation
interventions.description: Use pavement markings or physical barriers to define a clear, continuous pedestrian path through the large vehicle access area.

interventions.title: Street Trees and Buffer
interventions.description: Install a planting strip with street trees to provide a physical and psychological buffer between pedestrians and traffic.

interventions.title: Sidewalk Rehabilitation and Widening
interventions.description: Repair and widen the existing sidewalk to provide a clear, accessible path of at least 6 feet in width.

interventions.title: Vegetation Management
interventions.description: Regular maintenance and clearing of the buffer strip to improve visibility and eliminate potential hiding spots for debris.

interventions.title: Street Trees
interventions.description: Replacing the unmanaged weeds with street trees to provide a vertical buffer, shade, and a more pleasant walking environment.
